Threat Scenario: Phishing-delivered ransomware encrypts ERP/finance data, halting payroll and billing
Vulnerability: Limited phishing-resistant MFA; inconsistent security-awareness training; legacy VPN access to ERP
Existing Controls: Email filtering (basic), nightly backups (untested restore), antivirus on endpoints

Threat Scenario: Business email compromise (BEC) leads to a fraudulent wire transfer approval
Vulnerability: No dual-approval requirement above a set dollar threshold; spoofable sender display names not flagged
Existing Controls: Manual callback verification for new vendors (inconsistently followed)

Threat Scenario: Falsified or tampered environmental compliance data submitted to regulators (insider or integration error)
Vulnerability: No integrity checksums on waste-volume data exchange; limited audit trail on manual data corrections
Asset(s): A-09 Compliance Data Warehouse, A-10 Disposal Facility Exchange
Existing Controls: Monthly manual spot-check reconciliation by Compliance Officer

Threat Scenario: Unpatched IoT telematics units exploited as a pivot point into the corporate network
Vulnerability: Vendor-managed firmware with no formal patch SLA; telematics VLAN not fully segmented from corporate LAN
Existing Controls: Vendor manages patching (no visibility into cadence); partial network segmentation

Threat Scenario: Customer billing portal compromised via injection or broken access control, exposing customer payment data
Vulnerability: Portal has not had an independent security assessment since launch; no WAF in front of the application
Existing Controls: TLS in transit, PCI-scoped payment processor (tokenized, not stored directly)

Threat Scenario: Lost or stolen driver mobile device exposes cached credentials or customer service-location data
Vulnerability: No enforced mobile device management (MDM); devices not required to have remote wipe enabled
Existing Controls: App requires PIN on open; no remote wipe or MDM enrollment enforced

Threat Scenario: Weak depot guest Wi-Fi security allows an attacker on-site to reach internal systems
Vulnerability: Guest and staff Wi-Fi share a VLAN at two of six depots (legacy hardware)
Existing Controls: WPA2 in use; guest network exists but VLAN separation incomplete at 2 of 6 sites

Threat Scenario: Cloud data warehouse misconfiguration exposes environmental/compliance data externally
Vulnerability: No automated cloud security posture monitoring; access reviews are manual and infrequent
Existing Controls: Access restricted to Compliance team by default; no automated misconfiguration scanning

Threat Scenario: HR/Payroll SaaS breach exposes employee PII and banking details
Vulnerability: Single sign-on not enforced for the HR platform; standing admin accounts not regularly reviewed
Existing Controls: Vendor holds SOC 2 Type II; encrypted at rest per vendor attestation

Threat Scenario: DDoS against customer billing portal during month-end billing cycle disrupts payment collection
Vulnerability: No CDN/DDoS mitigation service in front of the portal
Existing Controls: Cloud host provides basic infrastructure-level protection only
Treatment: Accept (residual risk within appetite; revisit if traffic profile changes)
